target: 100% completion on the chosen PS4 remaster route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The remaster title screen, difficulty selector, save menu, and post-clear bonus menus.
areas.note: Chosen route: PlayStation 4 remaster on PS4 or PS5 compatibility.

save_backup.title: Create a rotating save set
save_backup.why: Campaign pickups cannot be recovered through chapter selection.

items.label: Use God of War III Remastered

levels.1: Confirm the remastered release before creating completion data.
levels.2: Use the PlayStation 4 remaster on PS4 or through PS5 backward compatibility.
levels.3: Launch God of War III Remastered, verify photo mode and the packaged downloadable content are present, and create a separate save set. No secondary platform-exclusive route is required.

levels.1: Campaign cleanup has no chapter-select safety net.
levels.2: Keep several manual saves and preserve one before leaving every major physical region.
levels.3: Rotate at least four save slots. Do not overwrite the most recent save from the prior region until its pickup list is checked; missed campaign objects otherwise require another playthrough.

levels.1: The first clear opens the post-clear completion layer.
levels.2: Finish the campaign once and retain the resulting clear data.
levels.3: Complete the final playable sequence, save the clear record, and return to the menu. Confirm Chaos difficulty, Challenge of Olympus, Fear costume, bonus galleries, and possession toggles are available.

levels.1: The harder starting preset deserves its own verified clear.
levels.2: Finish a complete campaign on Titan without lowering the setting.
levels.3: Begin Titan from a fresh file, keep the difficulty unchanged, and finish through clear-data creation. This also provides a clean rehearsal before the unlocked maximum setting.

levels.1: The maximum setting appears after the first clear.
levels.2: Start Chaos from the unlocked difficulty menu and finish the campaign.
levels.3: Select Chaos on a new campaign after clear data exists; weapons and magic do not normally carry over. Complete the full run without changing the preset and save its clear record.

areas.name: Heart of Gaia
areas.location_cue: A living stone chamber with vines climbing beside a large crystal formation.
areas.note: Finish this physical pickup sweep before taking the main exit.

save_backup.title: Preserve a save before leaving
save_backup.why: The campaign route may not return to these fixed pickup locations.

levels.1: A small flashing object is nearby and is not stored in a normal chest.
levels.2: Inside the vine-lined heart chamber, check the upper wall opening beside the crystals.
levels.3: Climb the vines bordering the crystal mass, pull into the opening at their top, and collect the flashing object on the right before leaving the chamber.

areas.name: Realm of Hades
areas.location_cue: A dark river region of grapple points, low shelves, vines, and movable heat sources.
areas.note: Finish this physical pickup sweep before taking the main exit.

save_backup.title: Preserve a save before leaving
save_backup.why: The campaign route may not return to these fixed pickup locations.

levels.1: Check optional ledges, hidden panels, and side routes before advancing.
levels.2: After the first underworld grapple, descend to the lower chest ledge.
levels.3: Swing from the grapple point, land on the forward shelf, then glide down to the ledge beneath it. Walk behind the visible chest group and open the container at the ledge's rear edge.

levels.1: Look beyond traversal devices and inspect spaces above or below the main path.
levels.2: Use the movable heat source beneath the vine-covered doorway.
levels.3: Push the burning cart below the high opening, ignite the vines with the bow, and ride the resulting updraft through the doorway. The chest is immediately inside on the left.

areas.name: The Depths of Hades

levels.2: Past the tunnel save point, burn the vines covering the next doorway.
levels.3: Follow the tunnel into the next chamber and shoot the vine barrier ahead with the bow. Open the chest directly behind the burned growth before continuing.

levels.1: Check optional ledges, hidden panels, and side routes before advancing.
levels.2: In the enemy chamber, take the broken-wall route down toward the waterfall.
levels.3: After the room is safe, exit through the wall opening, glide to the lower shelf, and follow the narrow handholds around the rock face. Complete the climbing chain to the waterfall and open the hidden chest behind it.

levels.3: Climb the stairs beside the large switch, descend toward the pedestal, and turn toward the damaged stair edge. Glide across the gap and follow the ledge to its concealed chest.

levels.1: Search mechanical detours and recesses that the forward route does not require.
levels.2: After the three trials, use the newly opened portal and search beyond the small tunnel.
levels.3: Step on the chain-side floor switch, enter the blue portal, and glide across the next gap. Pass the stone head, clear the short tunnel, turn sharply at its exit, and enter the second portal for the chest.

levels.3: Ignite the lower vines, ride the first updraft, and use the lift plus movable weight to strengthen the airflow. Pull down the upper grate, land on it, open the door, and follow the narrow passage to the chest.

levels.2: Before leaving the palace river, dive along its far-right side.
levels.3: Once the new chained weapon is available and the river route opens, enter the water at the far-right edge. Dive to the bottom and collect the flashing possession before swimming onward.

levels.3: After clearing the bridge, turn left at its far end and walk slowly along the boundary. The chest is concealed by the camera; press interact when the prompt appears.

levels.1: Search mechanical detours and recesses that the forward route does not require.
levels.2: In the third labyrinth room, use the movable block to reach the small wall ledge.
levels.3: Pull the block away from the entrance and align it with the light patch on the floor. Activate the left ice switch so the room rotates, climb onto the repositioned block, and jump to the narrow ledge for the chest.

areas.name: Heart of the Labyrinth
areas.location_cue: The inner mechanical chambers around gated walkways and a water-filled cube.
areas.note: Finish this physical pickup sweep before taking the main exit.

save_backup.title: Preserve a save before leaving
save_backup.why: The campaign route may not return to these fixed pickup locations.

levels.1: Check optional ledges, hidden panels, and side routes before advancing.
levels.2: Immediately outside the heart chamber gate, reveal the wall on the right.
levels.3: Open the indicated gate, step through it, and stop before crossing the next space. Shine the light item along the right-hand wall and open the chest that appears.

levels.1: Search mechanical detours and recesses that the forward route does not require.
levels.2: After the water-filled cube room, reveal the left wall at the exit.
levels.3: Complete the water-cube mechanism, leave through its opening, and aim the light item at the wall on the left. Open the concealed chest before following the companion route.

areas.name: Upper Labyrinth Bridge
areas.location_cue: A high bridge and adjoining mechanical room near a save light.
areas.note: Finish this physical pickup sweep before taking the main exit.

save_backup.title: Preserve a save before leaving

levels.1: Look beyond traversal devices and inspect spaces above or below the main path.
levels.2: In the room beyond the upper bridge save point, reveal the right wall.
levels.3: Enter the next chamber and pause before activating anything. Sweep the right-hand wall with the light item and open the chest that materializes.

areas.name: Top of the Labyrinth

levels.1: Check optional ledges, hidden panels, and side routes before advancing.
levels.2: From the top save point, glide across two cubes to the right and reveal the outer edge.
levels.3: Face the nearby companion marker, jump to the cube on the right, then continue to the next right-hand cube. Aim the light item along that cube's outside edge and open the chest.

levels.1: Look beyond traversal devices and inspect spaces above or below the main path.
levels.2: From the same save point, glide across two cubes to the left.
levels.3: Jump to the first cube on the left, then the next one farther left. Reveal the edge nearest the cube you crossed from and open the hidden chest.

levels.1: Search mechanical detours and recesses that the forward route does not require.
levels.2: Use the right cube first, then cross left and reveal that cube's right side.
levels.3: Glide from the save platform to the right cube, then move across to the neighboring cube on its left. Sweep the right face of the destination cube with the light item and open the chest.

areas.name: The Three Judges (return)
areas.location_cue: A broad circular chamber with a central chain, floor switch, portals, and three stone figures.
areas.note: Finish this physical pickup sweep before taking the main exit.

save_backup.title: Preserve a save before leaving

levels.1: Check optional ledges, hidden panels, and side routes before advancing.
levels.2: On returning to the chain chamber, reveal the wall across the pool.
levels.3: Walk around to the side opposite the water near the save point, aim the light item at the blank wall, and open the chest that appears.

levels.1: Check optional ledges, hidden panels, and side routes before advancing.
levels.2: Revisit the broken staircase near the chain's floor switch.
levels.3: Climb beside the large switch, descend toward the pedestal, turn to the damaged stair edge, and glide across. Follow the left ledge and open the replacement chest now present there.

levels.1: Look beyond traversal devices and inspect spaces above or below the main path.
levels.2: Use the chain switch and portal, then reveal the wall immediately left of the gap.
levels.3: Activate the large floor switch, enter the opened blue portal, and turn left on arrival. Shine the light item on the wall beside the gap and open the chest.

levels.1: Search mechanical detours and recesses that the forward route does not require.
levels.2: Beyond that portal, cross the gap and reveal the left wall after the tunnel.
levels.3: Exit the blue portal, glide left across the gap, and follow the walkway through the short tunnel. At its far end, sweep the wall on the left with the light item and open the chest.

levels.1: Search mechanical detours and recesses that the forward route does not require.
levels.2: Continue around the corner from the tunnel and enter the next blue portal.
levels.3: After crossing the gap and passing through the corridor, turn right and use the blue portal around the bend. Open the chest immediately after emerging.

levels.1: Check optional ledges, hidden panels, and side routes before advancing.

levels.3: Face the grapple used for progression, glide to the right cube and then the next right cube. Reveal the outside edge with the light item and open the respawned chest.

levels.1: Look beyond traversal devices and inspect spaces above or below the main path.

levels.3: Glide to the cube on the right, transfer to the neighboring cube on its left, and reveal the destination cube's right-hand face. Open the chest before using the grapple.

areas.name: Chamber of the Flame

levels.3: Face the chamber wall, move toward the large chain on the left, and reveal the adjacent wall panel with the light item. Enter the opening and collect the final surplus health chest.

areas.name: Arsenal and Meters
areas.location_cue: The pause-menu power-up screen and status display for weapons, tools, health, magic, and items.
areas.note: Maximize every primary weapon and all three permanent meters.

levels.1: Reserve red orbs for each primary tool until every upgrade node is purchased.
levels.2: Raise Blades of Exile to its maximum level and unlock the full Army of Sparta move set.
levels.3: Open the power-up screen whenever a red-orb threshold is reached, buy every level for Blades of Exile, and confirm no locked moves remain in its list. Test the final weapon technique and Army of Sparta once.

levels.1: Reserve red orbs for each primary tool until every upgrade node is purchased.
levels.2: Raise Claws of Hades to its maximum level and unlock the full Soul Summon move set.
levels.3: Open the power-up screen whenever a red-orb threshold is reached, buy every level for Claws of Hades, and confirm no locked moves remain in its list. Test the final weapon technique and Soul Summon once.

levels.1: Reserve red orbs for each primary tool until every upgrade node is purchased.

levels.3: Open the power-up screen whenever a red-orb threshold is reached, buy every level for Nemean Cestus, and confirm no locked moves remain in its list. Test the final weapon technique and Nemean Roar once.

levels.3: Open the power-up screen whenever a red-orb threshold is reached, buy every level for Nemesis Whip, and confirm no locked moves remain in its list. Test the final weapon technique and Nemesis Rage once.

levels.1: A campaign tool also contributes to the complete equipment ledger.
levels.2: Acquire Bow of Apollo and use it at least once outside its introduction.
levels.3: After the mandatory acquisition, open the equipment screen and confirm Bow of Apollo is listed. Use it on the next compatible traversal or combat target so its controls and meter behavior are verified.

levels.3: After the mandatory acquisition, open the equipment screen and confirm Boreas Icestorm is listed. Use it on the next compatible traversal or combat target so its controls and meter behavior are verified.

levels.1: The meter stops growing after a fixed number of matching pickups.
levels.2: Collect twelve Gorgon Eyes before relying on surplus chests.
levels.3: Open eye chests until the health bar reaches its cap and the twelfth pickup conversion completes. Continue opening every later eye chest; surplus containers convert to red orbs but remain part of the physical sweep.

levels.1: Do not stop opening matching chests when the bar appears nearly full.
levels.2: Collect twelve Phoenix Feathers to cap the magic meter.
levels.3: Confirm the twelfth feather produces the final magic-bar increase, then keep collecting the nine listed surplus feather chests for their converted red-orb contents.

levels.1: The secondary-tool meter has its own collectible track.
levels.2: Collect twelve Minotaur Horns to reach the item-meter cap.
levels.3: Verify the twelfth horn completes the yellow item bar. Open all eight later horn chests as well; they become red-orb rewards after the cap.

areas.name: Challenge of Olympus
areas.location_cue: The post-clear bonus menu and seven isolated combat or destruction arenas.
areas.note: Complete every listed trial to unlock Combat Arena.

levels.1: The campaign clear opens a seven-trial menu.
levels.2: Finish one campaign and select Challenge of Olympus from the bonus menu.
levels.3: Create clear data, return to the title menu, and open the challenge set. Confirm all seven trials are selectable; they may be completed in any order.

levels.1: Read the trial condition carefully before committing to an attack pattern.
levels.2: Keep the arena population at fifty or fewer.
levels.3: Push enemies out or eliminate them continuously; the trial fails the moment the active count rises above fifty.

levels.1: Read the trial condition carefully before committing to an attack pattern.
levels.2: Clear the arena before time expires without using weapons.
levels.3: Use grabs, throws, and environmental knockouts only. Keep moving toward clustered targets and restart immediately if a weapon attack is registered.

levels.1: Read the trial condition carefully before committing to an attack pattern.
levels.2: Become petrified ten times without dying.
levels.3: Invite each gaze, break free safely, and repeat until the counter reaches ten. Avoid being airborne or surrounded when the stone effect lands, because shattering ends the attempt.

levels.1: Read the trial condition carefully before committing to an attack pattern.
levels.2: Avoid both the charging minotaurs and the enemy pile-on.
levels.3: Stay near the arena's open center, dodge charges laterally, and keep smaller enemies away with short knockbacks. Any gore or group grab fails the condition.

levels.1: Read the trial condition carefully before committing to an attack pattern.
levels.2: Reach one thousand points through ring-outs.
levels.3: Damage the large target only enough to control it, then use its knockback force and your own launchers to send smaller enemies over the edge until the score reaches 1,000.

levels.1: Read the trial condition carefully before committing to an attack pattern.
levels.2: Cause five cyclopes to exist before time runs out.
levels.3: Damage each current cyclops rapidly so another spawns, but avoid finishing the final active set too slowly. Continue until the fifth spawn is counted before the timer expires.

levels.1: Read the trial condition carefully before committing to an attack pattern.
levels.2: Destroy every urn before time expires.
levels.3: Run a planned circuit around the room and use wide horizontal attacks rather than stopping for individual pots. Check the center last and restart if a distant urn survives the final seconds.

areas.name: Challenge of Exile
areas.location_cue: The remaster's second challenge menu and its seven standalone arenas.
areas.note: Complete all seven packaged downloadable trials.

levels.1: The remaster packages a second seven-trial set.
levels.2: Select Challenge of Exile from the remaster's bonus menu.
levels.3: Confirm the downloadable challenge set is installed with the remaster and open its selection screen. All seven trials should be available immediately.

levels.1: This downloadable trial has a distinct failure condition; plan around it.
levels.2: Eliminate fifteen airborne targets without touching the floor.
levels.3: Stay aloft with repeated grapples and spinning attacks; landing resets the counter. Reach fifteen within 120 seconds.

levels.1: This downloadable trial has a distinct failure condition; plan around it.
levels.2: Defeat fifty enemies while the equipped weapon changes every thirty seconds.
levels.3: Clear each wave aggressively and adapt at the 90-, 60-, and 30-second transitions. All fifty targets must fall before the 120-second clock ends.

levels.1: This downloadable trial has a distinct failure condition; plan around it.
levels.2: Keep the suspended cage from reaching the floor.
levels.3: Eliminations raise the cage, so prioritize quick kills whenever it begins dropping. Survive every wave until the arena ends; there is no fixed timer.

levels.1: This downloadable trial has a distinct failure condition; plan around it.
levels.2: Destroy sixty-nine emerging arms within forty-five seconds.
levels.3: Move around the arena in one direction while using broad blade sweeps. Avoid backtracking and clear all sixty-nine targets before the clock reaches zero.

levels.1: This downloadable trial has a distinct failure condition; plan around it.
levels.2: Break twelve shields without killing their owners.
levels.3: Spread light gauntlet hits across the group, then return to break weakened shields. Stop attacking each target once its shield is gone; any death fails the trial. Finish within sixty seconds.

levels.1: This downloadable trial has a distinct failure condition; plan around it.
levels.2: Create five chimera spawns before 270 seconds expire.
levels.3: Focus one creature through each of its forms, because a defeat produces additional spawns. Repeat quickly until the fifth spawn registers; do not waste time spreading damage across every active target.

levels.1: This downloadable trial has a distinct failure condition; plan around it.
levels.2: Defeat the mirror opponent and its supporting enemies.
levels.3: Use grabs on the three weaker enemies for space and damage, evade the mirror's long strings, and attack only after safe openings. The trial has no timer, so preserve health.

levels.3: Finish all seven Olympus trials, create a custom match, and change the difficulty, enemy roster, backdrop, costume, health, magic, and item settings. Start and finish or safely exit the configured fight.

levels.1: Collected possessions become usable only after a completed campaign.
